pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e1: {b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} We ask you to speak up for us with the board.
{b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} Could you raise the matter with the board?
pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e2: {b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} A word from you with the board would mean a lot to us.
{b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} The board is more likely to listen to you than to us.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e3: {b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} We are annoyed, we admit it, but we want to talk to you in a friendly way. Would you speak to the board?
{b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} The mood is not the best right now, yet we hope for your understanding and a word with the board.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e4: {b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} Tell those upstairs that the terrace stays empty if nothing changes!
{b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} If you do nothing there will soon be banners against the prices, before every home game!
pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e5: {b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} We stand behind the team and therefore calmly ask you to take the matter up with the board.
{b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} We want no quarrel, just an open ear on the board, and we would like your help with that.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e6: {b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} Whoever wants success needs atmosphere in the stadium, so please push for fairer prices.
{b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} Show us that you can move things away from the pitch too, and stand up for us with the board.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e7: {b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} We feel overlooked and would be grateful if you could get us a hearing at the board.
{b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss} {b.fans_ticketpreise_lage} This club means a lot to us, and it would mean much if you presented our concern.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e8: Coach, after the latest defeats nobody in the terraces understands why we should also dig deep into our pockets. Please talk to the board about prices.
First we lose games, then we are supposed to pay more for tickets and trips? Please push for a change.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e9: Ticket prices are now a topic in the papers and fan forums. Before it gets louder we ask you for a word with the board.
The media already talk about empty seats. Help to prevent a quarrel with the club.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.e.e10: Coach, you carry weight on the board, we know that. That is why we come to you: season ticket and away trip prices belong on the table.
The board values you, and that is exactly why we want you to present our worries about entry prices there.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a1: I will stand up for you with the board and demand cheaper season tickets and relief for away trips.
I will go to the board and present your demand, against resistance if necessary.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a2: Until the board has decided, a grant from our team fund for the away buses will help.
I will add something from the team fund for the trips so that the next journey stays doable for many.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a3: Prices are decided by the management, not by me. I will hand your letter in there and ask for a reply to you.
This belongs on the board's table, and I will make sure your mail arrives there.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a4: I understand that well. Anyone who comes with the family feels every price rise in the wallet, and I take that seriously.
You are right, the stadium must not become a luxury. I know what the games mean to you.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a5: Look at the table: the team delivers, and full stands follow success. In the end that will justify the prices.
We are doing well in sporting terms, and a club that plays at the top cannot be cheap.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a6: I reject the criticism of the prices. You have to decide for yourselves what the club is worth to you.
This is not my topic, and pressure from the terraces changes nothing. I will not be roped in for it.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a7: How many season tickets have actually been handed back, and which trips are most expensive? I can do more with figures at the board.
What exactly does an away trip cost you, and where does the shoe pinch most?
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a8: I will take your concern with me. I cannot promise you more than that today.
I see what moves you and will keep it in mind when I talk to people at the club.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a9: I do not interfere with pricing policy, and that is that. My job is the team.
I have nothing to say about prices and will not say anything about them.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a10: I invite you to a meeting with the board and will sit in, so you can present your figures yourselves.
Let us arrange a date together with the board. Then those responsible hear it from you, and I will support you.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a11: If I were allowed to give away tickets the terrace would be full by now. But I am only the coach and no treasurer, so keep that between us.
If entry prices depended on tactics we would have cut them long ago. I will remember your concern.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a12: Having to dig deep into your pockets after a defeat is doubly bitter. I understand that.
Especially when things go badly on the pitch, every extra euro hurts. Your anger is understandable.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.a.a13: Frankly, I consider the prices normal for the business. I see no reason to stir up trouble on the board over it.
To me this is an ordinary price level, so I will not start a campaign.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r1: {b.gut} That is more than we expected, we will pass it on in the terraces.
{b.gut} We can work with that, many thanks for your word.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r2: {b.gut} It is good that you take time for us, we appreciate that.
{b.gut} That is the coach we know, thank you for the open ear.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r3: {b.gut} Then we expect a result, but the start is made.
{b.gut} If action follows, the terraces will be behind the club again.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r4: {b.gut} That you listen means a great deal to many of us.
{b.gut} We had not dared to hope that you would see it this way.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r5: {b.gut} There you go, it works! We will tell the terraces right away.
{b.gut} At last someone who dares, and in front of the board at that.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r6: {b.neutral} We will discuss this at the fan meeting and get back to you.
{b.neutral} Whether that is enough will show in the next price lists.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r7: {b.neutral} Whether that is the right answer, we do not know yet.
{b.neutral} Opinions differ among us, we will see.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r8: {b.neutral} Fine, then we wait and see what the board says.
{b.neutral} We have time, but the season tickets for the new season will soon be due.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r9: {b.neutral} We will look at the prices once something is on the table.
{b.neutral} Talk helps, but figures help more, and we want to see them soon.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r10: {b.schlecht} We are not satisfied with that, and we will carry it to the terraces as it is.
{b.schlecht} That helps nobody, least of all the families who cannot afford the tickets.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r11: {b.schlecht} Then we will say it loudly, in the stadium, in front of all the cameras!
{b.schlecht} You leave us standing in the rain, we will not forget that!
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r12: {b.schlecht} Then even more seats will soon stay empty, that is up to each one.
{b.schlecht} Those who are not heard will simply save themselves the trip to the stadium.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.r.r13: {b.schlecht} We expected more from you, that really disappoints us.
{b.schlecht} We have always stood by you, and now this feels like a brush-off.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.x.x1: The fan spokesman says thank you. {entscheidung} The anger about prices dies down in the terraces, and calm returns for the next weeks.
{entscheidung} The fans take it kindly, and the first season tickets are collected again.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.x.x2: The terraces stay split. {entscheidung} Whether prices drop is finally for the board to decide.
{entscheidung} The fan spokesman wants to await the meeting before saying more.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.x.x3: The answer spreads fast. {entscheidung} At the next home game a banner against the prices hangs in the block, and the cameras zoom in.
{entscheidung} The fan forums argue fiercely the same evening, and the paper picks it up.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.x.x4: The fan spokesman does not write back. {entscheidung} The line to the terraces is cut for now.
{entscheidung} From now on the terraces stay silent on prices and keep their distance.
pool.fans_ticketpreise.x.x5: The fan spokesman reads out your promise in the terraces. {entscheidung} Now everyone watches closely what comes of it at the board.
{entscheidung} The fan council puts on record what you promised and will remind you at some point.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e1: {b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} We are planning a choreography for the next home game and wish that the team comes to the terraces after the final whistle.
{b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} May we hope for a joint salute from team and terraces after the game?
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e2: {b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} Tell us whether the players have a moment for the terraces after the final whistle, that would be the highlight for us.
{b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} We need your assurance that the team will answer our choreography with a salute.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e3: {b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} You seem tense and we do not want to disturb you. But a choreography and a salute from the team would do everybody good.
{b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} Perhaps this is not the best moment, yet we would be very glad about a sign from the team to the terraces.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e4: {b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} This will be the biggest show this stadium has ever seen, and the players simply must come to us afterwards!
{b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} After a game like that the terraces want to see their heroes, so please send them over to us!
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e5: {b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} It need not be elaborate, just a shared moment between team and terraces, if it suits you.
{b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} If it can be arranged the lads come over to us briefly, completely relaxed and without a big programme.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e6: {b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} Together with the terraces this team is hard to beat, and the opponent should see and hear that in the stadium.
{b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} A salute from the team after the game would make the terraces even louder, and you benefit most from that.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e7: {b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} For many of us it is something very special to thank the players in person, please give us that moment.
{b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss} {b.fans_lob_choreo_lage} We have been working on the choreography for weeks and would be very glad about a salute from the team.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e8: Coach, one rarely experiences a run like this, and we want to honour it with a choreography. Will the team come to us after the game?
The terraces have not cheered in a row for such a long time. We thank you with a choreography and hope for the players' salute.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e9: Coach, we have long wished to see the club at the top of the table. We are planning a choreography and wish for the team with us afterwards.
We want to show with a big picture in the block that the club plays at the top. Will the players come to us afterwards?
pool.fans_lob_choreo.e.e10: Coach, the press is writing about us and we would like a picture for the cameras, team and terraces together after the game.
Everyone is talking about this run, and we want it to be seen in the terraces too. What do you think of a salute after the final whistle?
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a1: We will come to the terraces together after the game, I promise you. You have earned it.
The team will step in front of your block after the final whistle, I will see to that.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a2: I will discuss it with the captain and the squad council, the salute should come from the players themselves.
How the team thanks you is for the players to decide. I will pass your request on to the captain.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a3: The thanks are yours. We have not won anything yet, but without you this run would not have been possible.
We stay humble, because the season is long. But what your terraces do really helps us on the pitch.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a4: Let us plan it for the home game after next, then I will have the team better in view.
I would like to do it, but not right now. Ask again after the next home game.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a5: The schedule is too tight, I will not let the lads lose time and strength after the game too. The answer is no.
Because of the schedule I have to decline, the players need recovery after the final whistle, not a ceremony.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a6: The team donates a bonus to the terraces. With it you can pay for material for the choreography and flags.
Part of our win bonus goes to your block as thanks for the atmosphere.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a7: What exactly do you have in mind, how long will it take, and where should the players stand? Then I can plan it.
How do you imagine the procedure, and who from the terraces is my contact person?
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a8: We celebrate after the season, before that there are no gestures and no appearances. I stick to that.
As long as we have won nothing, this team does not show itself in front of the terraces. That is my line.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a9: I will explain the procedure: after the final whistle comes the review, afterwards the players come to you briefly, as far as the schedule allows.
After the game there is recovery and interviews, but a short salute towards the terraces is possible.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a10: If the lads keep winning they will soon run over to you by themselves, and I will only be in the way.
If I do not send the players over they will come anyway, I know their pride. I will let you know.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a11: Thank you for all you do for us. I know how much work and heart goes into every choreography.
That really touches me. You make this stadium a special place, and the players feel it too.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a12: Instead of after the game I suggest a meeting during the week, the captain, a few players and I will come to you.
We would rather meet at the training ground, the team has more peace there, and I will bring the players along.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.a.a13: Should I risk a win because of a choreography? The lads should concentrate on the next game, not on your show.
Do you want the team to lose focus just because the terraces want to paint a picture?
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r1: {b.gut} That makes us truly happy, the whole terrace will hear about it.
{b.gut} We had hoped for such an answer and are still hugely delighted.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r2: {b.gut} That is exactly how we know you, and exactly why we stand behind you.
{b.gut} That is a nice thing, thank you for your word and for the calm.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r3: {b.gut} Then we will make it something the whole league talks about.
{b.gut} Great, and we will keep pushing the team forward, promised.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r4: {b.gut} That touched us deeply, many heartfelt thanks.
{b.gut} We had not expected so much warmth, we will not forget it.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r5: {b.gut} Yes, then we give everything in the stadium and make it really big!
{b.gut} That will be a party, we are starting with preparations right away!
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r6: {b.neutral} We will discuss it in the terraces and get back to you.
{b.neutral} Then we wait and see how it develops, there is still some time until the next home game.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r7: {b.neutral} We are not sure how to take it, we will see.
{b.neutral} Mixed feelings on our side, but we will stay on it.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r8: {b.neutral} No problem, then we simply do the choreography without much ado.
{b.neutral} We stay relaxed, the run goes on after all, hopefully.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r9: {b.neutral} As long as the team keeps delivering, we will take care of the rest.
{b.neutral} Fine, then the next results count, and we will make the atmosphere.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r10: {b.schlecht} A pity, we pictured it differently, and so did many in the terraces.
{b.schlecht} We are not happy with that, and we will pass that on.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r11: {b.schlecht} We have carried this team for weeks, and this is the thanks? We will not forget it!
{b.schlecht} Then we will sing without you, but do not forget who roared you to victory!
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r12: {b.schlecht} If the team has nothing for us we will spare ourselves the trouble in future.
{b.schlecht} Then the mood will sink once the run ends.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.r.r13: {b.schlecht} That hurts, we had hoped that we mean more to you.
{b.schlecht} After everything we have done for you we had expected more understanding.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.x.x1: The fan spokesman thanks you warmly. {entscheidung} The terraces prepare the choreography with twice the enthusiasm.
{entscheidung} In the block there is painting and sewing, and the mood around the club has rarely been so good.
pool.fans_lob_choreo.x.x2: The terraces take it calmly. {entscheidung} Whether and when the choreography happens stays open.
{entscheidung} The fan council keeps planning but wants to announce nothing before the next games.

{entscheidung} The paper writes of a rift between terraces and coach, in the middle of the run.

{entscheidung} The terraces keep their annoyance to themselves and withdraw.
